nodes.label: Joint mapping constraint
nodes.statement: If H_A is nonempty and f0 belongs to it, H_A=f0*Aut(X)_A and possible images of x are f0(Aut(X)_A x). A target is identified exactly when constant over H_A. Separate per-anchor satisfiability does not imply joint satisfiability; the eight-cycle adjacent-to-antipodal pair is an exact witness. Compatible adjacent anchors can determine all remaining matches.
